places.name: Chiostro del Bramante
places.note: Bramante's first Roman work, a cloister of perfect proportion two streets from Piazza Navona. The upstairs café looks into Raphael's Sibyls next door.

places.name: Tempietto del Bramante
places.address: Piazza di San Pietro in Montorio 2
places.note: A small round temple in a courtyard on the Gianicolo, the High Renaissance distilled to a single room. Walk up from Trastevere and stay for the view.

places.name: Quartiere Coppedè
places.note: A few streets of fantasy built between 1913 and 1927: Art Nouveau, Gothic and Baroque at once, with a frog fountain in the middle. Come on a Sunday morning.

places.name: Centrale Montemartini
places.note: Classical marbles set among the turbines of a 1912 power station. Goddesses against cast iron. One of the city's least crowded museums.

places.name: Giardino degli Aranci
places.note: An orange grove on the Aventine with the whole city spread out below. Afterwards, look through the keyhole at the Knights of Malta gate down the road.

places.name: Palazzo Doria Pamphilj
places.note: A private family palace that still lives on the Corso. Velázquez's Innocent X hangs in its own small room. Take the audio guide narrated by a prince of the family.

places.name: MAXXI
places.note: Zaha Hadid's concrete ribbons, stairs that fly through the void. Come for the building as much as the art, and walk the piazza after dark.

places.name: Palazzo della Civiltà Italiana
places.note: The 'square Colosseum': arches stacked six by nine in white travertine. Rationalist, unsettling, beautiful. Now Fendi's headquarters; the ground floor hosts exhibitions.

places.name: Roscioli Salumeria
places.note: A delicatessen with tables among the hams and cheeses. Carbonara as a reference point, and a wine list to match. Book; then get bread from their bakery round the corner.

places.name: Bar San Calisto
places.note: An unrenovated bar where Trastevere still drinks. Plastic chairs, cheap Peroni, a famous chocolate. The antidote to the aperitivo terraces.

places.name: Drink Kong
places.address: Piazza di San Martino ai Monti 8
places.note: A neon-lit cocktail bar in Monti, all Blade Runner red. Inventive drinks, serious hospitality. Arrive early or expect to wait.
